description:
Today we go over how to calculate specular highlights. I show how to use the Phong formula and the Blinn formula. As a bonus, I also show how to do Half Lambert diffuse.

Take a look at the playlist for the whole series:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL78XDi0TS4lGnGa7L2X4o3UV-XYZEKNwj

Here's last week's video that introduces the series:
https://youtu.be/4Y5eKDwZ4GY
